title: Harden FFmpeg ONNX/CUDA and Hungarian content/voice pipelines
decisions: Treat FFmpeg ONNX CUDA execution and ONNX zero-copy as separate claims.
Do not promote zero-copy without device-memory I/O binding and profiler evidence of zero host transfers.
Use hardware-agnostic CUDA architecture detection/override instead of fixed sm_86/sm_90.
Make nonfree FFmpeg licensing an explicit opt-in policy, not an unconditional build flag.
Require cryptographically verifiable, purpose-bound, revocable consent for voice cloning.
Keep Piper generic Hungarian TTS separate from XTTS voice cloning; never silently substitute it.
Require Host Resource Broker lease acquisition and release for GPU voice cloning.
Deny voice providers/models/voices until license and intended-use admission is APPROVED.
Never synthesize CURRENT_HOST PASS from portable CI, mocks, or build success.
